sanskrit_verse:
प्रतिज्ञां भावयेद् वादी प्रत्यर्थी कारणं तथा ।
प्राग्वृत्तवादी विजयं जयपत्त्रेण भावयेत् ॥
transliteration: pratijñāṃ bhāvayed vādī pratyarthī kāraṇaṃ tathā / prāgvṛttavādī vijayaṃ jayapattreṇa bhāvayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: The plaintiff shall affirm their claim, the defendant shall present counter-reasoning, and the one who has previously acted in accordance with truth shall be established in victory through the instrument of righteous verdict.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from alignment with Satyagraha (truth-force), not positional power
Causation is determined by prior dharmic action, not procedural formality
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by integrity-consistency over time
Restoration logic operates through re-establishment of factual dharma, not punitive reversal
Consciousness alignment determines the validity of claims before external evidence
executable_legal_axioms: IF a party's current claim aligns with their past verifiable dharmic actions, THEN that party is prima facie entitled to prevail
IF both parties have equal dharmic consistency, THEN resolution defaults to the first declarative assertion made in conscious witness
IF a claimant recants or contradicts prior truthful declarations, THEN automatic disqualification occurs without penalty
IF no prior action exists to determine alignment, THEN neutral arbiter shall invoke pramana-based inquiry until clarity emerges organically
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this axiom establishes that judicial authority derives not from precedent alone but from the ontological congruence between litigant conduct and cosmic order. Judgment must reflect the inherent moral trajectory of the actor, rendering procedural dominance secondary to existential integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here functions as the revelation of pre-existing causal harmony rather than corrective imposition. Victory is not awarded as reward nor defeat as punishment; it is simply the manifestation of what already was—aligned consciousness asserting its own continuity through rightful outcome.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Party found misaligned must undergo guided reflection until inner contradiction dissolves naturally
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Each disputant reaffirms personal sovereignty over future choice-making within dharma
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reintegrate losing party into societal function via purpose-aligned service pathways
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Public acknowledgment and correction of false stance without shame or stigma
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
